extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: To allow users to visually edit complex HTML files, such as AI-generated presentations and reports, without needing to modify the source code.
problem: Users must leave Obsidian and edit raw code when they want to make simple changes to AI-generated HTML presentations or reports.
summary: HTML Studio allows users to read, view, and visually edit HTML files, including slide decks and long reports, directly within Obsidian.
